name: io.github.profalexandrezamboni-ui/specgate
title: SpecGate Deterministic DevSecOps MCP Server
description: Deterministic OpenAPI 3.x SemVer diff, SPF 10-lookup flattener & WCAG 2.2 / EN 301 549 MCP server.

tools.name: specgate_openapi_diff
tools.description: Deterministically compare base vs. head OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 or JSON Schema specs to detect breaking API changes, compute exact MAJOR/MINOR/PATCH SemVer bumps, and generate PR review comments (<15ms, zero LLM).

base_spec.description: Base OpenAPI 3.x / JSON Schema object or JSON string (e.g., from main branch).

head_spec.description: Head OpenAPI 3.x / JSON Schema object or JSON string (e.g., from Pull Request).

format.description: Optional output format: 'json' (default) or OASIS 'sarif' v2.1.0.

tools.name: spfguard_analyze_spf
tools.description: Audit DNS SPF records against the RFC 7208 Section 4.6.4 10-lookup ceiling, optionally resolve live DNS via DoH, and generate flattened CIDR records + RFC 8461 MTA-STS policies.

spf_record.description: Optional raw v=spf1 TXT record string; omit when resolve_live_dns=true.

resolve_live_dns.description: If true, fetch live DNS TXT via Cloudflare DoH before counting lookups.

format.description: Optional output format: 'json' (default) or OASIS 'sarif' v2.1.0.

tools.name: a11yratchet_evaluate_audit
tools.description: Evaluate rendered axe-core JSON violations against a monotonic baseline ratchet and map findings deterministically to WCAG 2.2 AA and European Accessibility Act EN 301 549 V3.2.1 Chapter 9 clauses.

axe_report.description: axe-core JSON report object containing a 'violations' array.

format.description: Optional output format: 'json' (default) or OASIS 'sarif' v2.1.0.
